policy_source: engine/rust/question_selection.rs:111-218; seen_before_task excludes previous task items; caller excludes current prefix; select deduplicates entity IDs, selects positive-weight nonempty band, then uniform SHA256 within band. No policy chooses within a band by template or answer.
analytic_conclusion: At any positive easy weight each fresh easy survivor is equally eligible, so no source-dependent selection gate removes a numerical decision case. Existing inventory includes five historically weak sign banks; mixed pool is not certified free of those old items. Zero easy weight excludes this new easy batch. Unconfigured policy deterministically picks lowest entity ID.
limitations: Actual future DB entity IDs, learner histories and configured weights unavailable. New IDs are synthetic to run representative orderings; uniform eligibility is independent of within-band ordering.
Seen histories can leave arbitrary nonempty subsets; no finite five-item pool promises all templates after arbitrary exclusions.
Publication absent: faithfully reproduced normalization and filtering against captured basis 5370. No publication or DB writes.
